newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's firm pre-tax profit $6.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's firm pre-tax profit $6.4 mln.

text.p: Moroccan mineral water company Oulmes showed on Monday a pre-tax profit of 55.9 million dirhams ($6.4 million) in the first half in 1996, up from 48.7 million dirhams ($5.6 million) in the same period in 1995.
The Societe Fermiere des Sources Minerales Oulmes S.A posted a turnover of 86.3 million dirhams in the first half of 1996, slightly up from 81.9 million in the same period last year.
One of the 46 listed stocks on the Casablanca bourse, Oulmes shares were last traded at 410 dirhams.
Established in Casablanca in 1934, Oulmes has a capital of 15 million dirhams and employs more than 300 workers and technicians.
It has a production capacity of 250,000 bottles of mineral water per day.
